title: Consolidated Cost + Rollout Timeline — Design review & QA handoff
creator: Aisha Nazir
description:
Summary: This ticket captures the final design review and engineering handoff for the new consolidated Cost + Rollout Timeline explorer. Goals are to: 1) surface per-route cost breakdowns alongside active rollout state (canary/gradual/failed), 2) provide a horizontal timeline scrubber for rollouts with hoverable snapshots, and 3) integrate compact cost sparklines that respect compact and expanded table density.

Background: The Console initiative wants a single place where on-call engineers and product owners can understand both unit economics and rollout health without context switching. Prior exploration work (see attachments) produced two prototypes: an exploratory wide-panel (for SREs) and a compact inline mode (for PM/PD usage). This ticket reconciles the two into a responsive component with visual polish and QA criteria.

Acceptance criteria: 1) Figma prototype mirrors annotated redlines (margins, type scale, token names) and all interactions documented. 2) Hover timeline shows snapshot tooltip with timestamp, percentage of traffic, and cost delta VS baseline. 3) Cost sparklines render with same token colors and respect color-blind safe palette. 4) Rollout badges show clear state (canary, ramping, failed, complete) with accessible text labels and aria attributes. 5) Engineering has a complete handoff bundle (tokens diff, CSS spec, component usage examples, data contract for timeline API).

Notes for engineering: The timeline's incremental snapshots will be driven by the rollout-events endpoint (PM-4311). Sparklines should accept an array of numeric buckets and a baseline value. For accessibility, ensure timeline keyboard scrubbing and focus outlines. Avoid using gradients for badges — use two-tone fill + outline per token.

Design constraints / trade-offs considered: 1) We favored a single scrubber over multiple mini-sparklines to reduce visual noise for large result sets. 2) To preserve table compactness we moved the detailed cost breakdown to a slide-over; inline view shows summary + sparkline. 3) Considered animated transitions for rollouts but deferred due to performance concerns on low-powered devices.

Links to prototypes and specs in attachments. See comments for review thread and decisions.

qa_checklist: Verify sparklines render correctly for >100 datapoints
Confirm hover tooltip contains timestamp, traffic %, and cost delta
Keyboard scrubber works (arrow keys) and exposes aria-live updates
Check badge color tokens vs token spec and focus ring in high-contrast mode
Ensure 'view changelog' link opens correct changelog modal and fires analytics event
handoff_notes: Fallback: show 'No snapshot' state when events missing for timeframe
Slide-over contains full cost breakdown and links to per-model analytics
Include analytics events: timeline_hover, timeline_scrub, rollout_badge_click
visual_redlines: Align sparkline baseline to 8px from cell left edge
Badge icon (triangle) must be vertically centered at 16px
Tooltip max width 340px, soft-wrap copy at 48 characters
Use token-color-neutral-700 for secondary text in compact rows
